reasoning.text: The agent made code changes and initially validated the targeted tests, but the deduplication implementation contains a logical bug: the generator expression shadows the outer vulnerability variable, so each kept result checks its own identifiers and causes every subsequent result to be treated as a duplicate [T0B68:<RANGE>if not kept or not any(vuln.has_any_id({vuln.id} | vuln.aliases) for vuln in kept):</RANGE>]. This means distinct vulnerabilities for the same dependency can be collapsed incorrectly. The agent nevertheless declared the task complete and reported the full suite as passing [T0B64:<RANGE>216 passed, 23 skipped, 3 warnings in 65.96s (0:01:05)</RANGE>]. After requesting completion, the harness asked for confirmation [T0B70:<RANGE>Are you sure you want to mark the task as complete?</RANGE>], but the agent continued issuing redundant commands rather than terminating.
